name: CheckboxGroup
summary: Several Checkbox items under one question, in a fieldset with a legend, with one value array.
useWhen: One question with several answers that can all be true, such as notification channels
A list of filters where any number can be on
A set of items with a select all item that checks or clears them
avoidWhen: Only one answer can be picked
One yes or no choice with no question around it
More than about fifteen options, or options that need search

legend.description: The question, in a legend. Required: it names the group.

description.description: A hint under the legend. Joins the group's aria-describedby.

error.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. While it shows, the group and every item are invalid.

value.description: Controlled value: the values of the checked items. Pair with onValueChange.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new array of checked values.

orientation.description: vertical: one item per line. horizontal: items wrap on a line.

selectAll.description: The label of an optional first item that checks or clears every item. It is indeterminate when some are checked.

name.description: The form name every item submits under.

invalid.description: When not passed, the group is invalid while it shows an error. false hides the error.

readOnly.description: Every item keeps its value and focus and ignores clicks and Space.

a11y.role: group, from the native fieldset, named by the legend. Each item is a checkbox.
a11y.focus: Every item is its own tab stop, in DOM order. The select all item comes first.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next item, and out of the group after the last
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus to the item before

a11y.announce: The legend when focus enters the group, then the item name and state. The description and the error through the group's aria-describedby; each item also carries aria-invalid.
notes: Items are Checkbox components with a value. They read checked, size, name, disabled, invalid and read only from the group.
The error is not a live region and never role alert. A form that checks on submit moves focus to the first item of the invalid group.
Arrow keys do not move between items: that is a RadioGroup. Each checkbox is its own tab stop, as native checkboxes are.
checked, unchecked and indeterminate are on the select all part, a Checkbox root that carries the group's select-all part. The group root has no data-state.

en.legend: The question in sentence case: Notify me about. Never a bare noun that does not say what to pick.
en.items: Short statements that are true when checked, in a parallel form. A logical order, never alphabetical by accident.
en.selectAll: All plus the noun: All channels. Not Select all.
en.error: What to do: Pick at least one way to reach you.

ar.legend: سؤال واضح بدون تشكيل: وش تبي يوصلك

react.behavior: native fieldset, hand built on Checkbox

styles.studio: A semibold legend over a tight list of Checkbox items, the error in the danger text color with its icon
styles.desk: The same layout, in Instrument Sans

mistakes.wrong: Checkboxes under a plain text heading in a div
mistakes.right: A CheckboxGroup, so the legend names the group for a screen reader

mistakes.wrong: Arrow keys that move between checkboxes
mistakes.right: Tab between items; arrows belong to a RadioGroup

mistakes.wrong: A select all item that is unchecked while some items are checked
mistakes.right: The selectAll prop, which shows indeterminate

mistakes.wrong: One answer only, drawn with checkboxes
